issues.detail: The Hebrew says 'the sons of Jaaziah: his son' (בְּנֵי יַעֲזִיָּהוּ בְנוֹ), i.e., Jaaziah's son (singular, unnamed). The Chinese adds '比挪' (Beno), a name not present in the Hebrew text, and renders it as '雅西雅的兒子是比挪' (the son of Jaaziah is Beno), which is an addition of a name not in the source.
